name: Codex connection
responsibility: Opens one Codex child's connection, its epoch, identity authorities and transport, and opens sessions on it
description: TASK-653.11, ./connection. openCodexConnection({ child, recordPrefix }) returns a plain-data CodexConnection (child, epoch, identity, transport) with no function-valued member: a fresh child and epoch from the record prefix, the authorities that name identities in them, and the transport over the child's stdio. A child that already exited yields a closed transport, so the host registers its dynamic dispatchers after open and only while the transport is open, and no namespace TypeError is thrown. openCodexSession(connection, options) returns { session, control }; the caller owns the control, which delivers the transport's notifications and server requests to the session and disposes of it. One connection belongs to one child and one epoch; the process that yields the children stays apart (ADR 0089).

outgoing.label: the transport over the child's stdio
